task_instance: Interpret an individual Culture Index profile from JSON input (option 1: 'Interpret an individual profile'): given a sample person's Survey and Job trait JSON (A/B/C/D/Logic/Ingenuity with arrow-relative values, plus EU), produce an interpretation that (a) uses distance-from-arrow rather than absolute trait values for A/B/C/D, (b) uses absolute values for Logic/Ingenuity, (c) compares Survey vs Job graphs to flag behavior modification, (d) computes Energy Utilization = (Job EU / Survey EU) x 100 and classifies healthy/stress/frustration, and (e) reports key findings and recommendations without value judgments.
evidence: Created a realistic sample profile at jane_doe.json (Survey: A [8,+3.2], B [7,+2.5], C [2,-1.8], D [2,-2.0], Logic [6], Ingenuity [7], EU 24; Job: A [7,+2.1], B [5,+0.9], C [4,+0.2], D [4,+0.1], EU 34) matching the exact JSON schema documented in SKILL.md's <input_formats>. Wrote interpret.py implementing the skill's essential_principles (distance-from-arrow labeling table: Normative/Tendency/Pronounced/Extreme; L/I absolute-value exception; EU formula and 70/130% thresholds from <quick_reference>) since the skill source directory (trailofbits__skills__interpreting-culture-index) contained only SKILL.md and LICENSE -- the scripts/extract_pdf.py and workflows/references markdown files it points to were not actually present in this source snapshot, so the interpretation logic was implemented directly from the principles embedded in SKILL.md. Ran `python3 interpret.py jane_doe.json`, producing a complete, correct interpretation: Survey traits labeled Extreme/Pronounced relative to the arrow, Job traits shown moderating toward the arrow on C/D (behavior modification flagged), EU utilization computed as (34/24)x100=142% correctly classified as STRESS/burnout risk (>130% threshold), largest Survey-to-Job shift identified (D, +2.1 centiles), and a findings/recommendations summary with no absolute-only trait comparisons and no good/bad value judgments -- satisfying every item in the skill's own <verification_loop> checklist. Output saved to interpretation_output.txt.
